## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION: Narrow/weak market, Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Credit stress rising — HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND; LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY) and broad weakness in SPY (SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND) confirm pressure despite VXX (VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND) showing complacency.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND). Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND. Reflation signals from commodities: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar strength (Dollar index 1W: +0.78% | 1M: +1.76%) ABOVE TREND and yield-curve slightly steepening (Yield Curve (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +0.04%) ABOVE TREND); TLT (TLT (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY) shows duration hedging.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech-led but narrow: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND and Healthcare breadth positive (Healthcare (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.67%) RECOVERY); Financials (XLF (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND) and discretionary weak. Style: Growth/Tech showing strength but leadership is narrow.

5. US vs Global?  
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND while QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND. Emerging markets soft: EEM (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION and China FXI (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -3.81%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation healthy: IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND; small caps IWM (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -5.59%) BELOW TREND showing selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Reflation tone: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND; broad commodity strength on 1M, but several energy/agri ETFs show 1W pullbacks. Gold GLD (1W: +0.60% | 1M: -3.06%) RECOVERY — safe-haven interest persistent.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION while UNG (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND — oil/brent show 1M strength with near-term softness (BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: XLK and QQQ both timeframes positive (XLK ABOVE TREND; QQQ ABOVE TREND). Minor divergence: TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) and narrow sector breadth (2/11) — no major multi-core ETF divergence but monitor persistence.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor selective exposure to Tech/innovation and crypto-linked ETFs showing strength (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND; ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND; IBIT ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to Financials and small caps (XLF (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND; IWM BELOW TREND); bonds neutral/hedging via TLT RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLF (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND, XLY (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -8.92%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT/crypto ETFs (IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND).  
BEARISH: BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION — watch oil’s 1W pullback vs 1M strength.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND) for complacency; HYG/LQD ~0.75 (HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND) for credit health; XLK/XLF ratio ~3.39 (Tech vs Financials) as growth vs value pivot; Breadth: 2/11 as the immediate guardrail.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION: Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, narrow market with mixed signals. XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG/LQD down) and the persistently narrow breadth — monitor TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) as a divergence signal.
